groups.label: Price
groups.description: Price levels and records: quotes, bars, session levels, and rolling highs & lows — plus the signals those levels own (at / above / approaching / breaking).

categories.label: Trades & quotes
categories.description: Last trade and the current quote: price, bid/ask, and depth.

categories.label: Latest bars
categories.description: OHLC of the latest minute bar and the prior session's daily bar.

categories.label: Session levels & position
categories.description: Today's session levels (open, high, low) and where price sits relative to them and yesterday's landmarks.

categories.label: Highs & lows
categories.description: Rolling-window highs and lows (5-day, 20-day, 52-week), their dates and distances, and the at/approaching/breaking signals those levels own.

groups.label: Volume
groups.description: How much traded: absolute quantities and averages, and activity relative to baseline.

categories.label: Volume & averages
categories.description: Absolute trading quantities: today's and prior volumes, dollar volume, averages, bar-level counts.

categories.label: Relative & unusual volume
categories.description: Trading activity relative to baseline: relative volume, bursts, unusual-volume flags, liquidity conditions.

groups.label: Price action
groups.description: How price is moving: behaviors recognized directly from the price record — changes, gaps, momentum episodes, range structures — with no indicator in between.

categories.label: Performance & change
categories.description: Price change over standard horizons — today through 1 year — plus streaks and day-mover flags.

categories.label: Gaps
categories.description: Opening gaps: size, direction, extremes, and intraday fill.

categories.label: Intraday momentum
categories.description: Directional strength read straight off the session's bars: drives, drifts, spikes, rallies, exhaustion.

categories.label: Ranges & reversals
categories.description: Range structures and their resolution: opening range, breaks, consolidation, pullbacks, reversals, unusual range width.

groups.label: Technicals
groups.description: Named technical indicators (SMA, EMA, VWAP, RSI, stochastics, MACD, ADX, Bollinger, ATR) and every signal computed through one. The test: a named mathematical object sits between the bars and the signal.

categories.label: Moving averages & VWAP
categories.description: SMAs, EMAs, and VWAPs, with the distances, above/below states, and crosses they own.

categories.label: Oscillators
categories.description: Bounded momentum oscillators: RSI and stochastics, with their threshold flags.

categories.label: Trend & direction
categories.description: Trend direction and strength: MACD, ADX/±DI, SMA-based trend reads, and reversal composites.

categories.label: Volatility & bands
categories.description: Volatility measures and deviation envelopes: ATR, Bollinger machinery, VWAP σ-bands.

groups.label: Fundamentals
groups.description: Company financials: statement lines as reported, ratios derived from them, market-price multiples on top of them, share structure, and short positioning.

categories.label: Income statement
categories.description: Income-statement lines as reported, EPS, and their growth rates.

categories.label: Balance sheet
categories.description: Balance-sheet lines as reported.

categories.label: Cash flow
categories.description: Cash-flow-statement lines and free cash flow.

categories.label: Margins & ratios
categories.description: Ratios computed entirely from statement lines — margins, returns, liquidity, leverage. No market price in the formula.

categories.label: Valuation
categories.description: Metrics crossing market price with financials — cap, EV, multiples, yield, beta — plus the size/style tags they own (cap tiers, beta tags, value_stock).

categories.label: Share structure & ownership
categories.description: How the equity is divided and held: share counts, float and its tags, insider/institutional ownership, ETF holders.

categories.label: Short interest
categories.description: Short positioning: readings, ratios, days-to-cover, and their flags.

groups.label: Events
groups.description: What happened or is scheduled to happen to the company: earnings, dividends, IPOs, share-capital changes, insider transactions.

categories.label: Earnings
categories.description: The earnings calendar and its outcomes: dates, windows, surprises, streaks.

categories.label: Dividends
categories.description: Dividend amount, schedule, and approach flags.

categories.label: IPOs
categories.description: IPO dates and status, from pending through recently listed.

categories.label: Splits & share changes
categories.description: Events that alter share count or float: splits, buybacks, dilution.

categories.label: Insider activity
categories.description: Insider (Form 4) transaction flags: C-suite buys and sells, clustered buying.

groups.label: Profile
groups.description: Who and what the security is: categorical classification and identity data. Lookup information, not signals.

categories.label: Classification
categories.description: Categorical facts: sector, industry, SIC, exchange, country, currency, asset class and sub-class.

categories.label: Identifiers & reference
categories.description: Which company this is: name, IDs (CIK, FIGI), listing status, contact, branding, employees.

groups.label: Analyst ratings
groups.description: Third-party analyst judgment: the consensus, individual firm actions, price targets, and forward estimates.

categories.label: Consensus ratings
categories.description: The aggregate analyst opinion: consensus rating, the buy/hold/sell distribution, coverage depth.

categories.label: Upgrades & downgrades
categories.description: Individual firm actions: rating changes, initiations, and price-target changes.

categories.label: Price targets
categories.description: Where analysts say it's going: consensus/high/low targets and price-versus-target state.

categories.label: Estimates
categories.description: What analysts say it will earn: forward EPS/revenue estimates and their revisions.

groups.label: News
groups.description: Signals derived from news coverage: article volume and sentiment.

categories.label: News
categories.description: News coverage signals: article volume and volume-weighted sentiment.

fields.name: accounts_payable
fields.description: Trade payables to suppliers as of the quarter end.

fields.name: address_address1
fields.description: Company headquarters street address.

fields.name: address_city
fields.description: Company headquarters city.

fields.name: address_postal_code
fields.description: Company headquarters postal code.

fields.name: address_state
fields.description: Company headquarters state or region.

fields.name: adx_14
fields.description: Average Directional Index (14-period): trend strength from 0 to 100.

fields.name: analyst_consensus_rating
fields.description: Consensus analyst rating across contributing firms. One of `strong buy`, `buy`, `hold`, `sell`, `strong sell`. NULL for tickers without analyst coverage.

fields.name: analyst_consensus_rating_value
fields.description: Consensus rating as a numeric score on the standard 1–5 scale (1 = strong buy, 5 = strong sell). Lower is more bullish.

fields.name: analyst_consensus_target_price
fields.description: Mean of contributing analysts' 12-month price targets.

fields.name: analyst_count_buy
fields.description: Number of contributing firms rating the ticker as buy.

fields.name: analyst_count_hold
fields.description: Number of contributing firms rating the ticker as hold (neutral).

fields.name: analyst_count_sell
fields.description: Number of contributing firms rating the ticker as sell.

fields.name: analyst_count_strong_buy
fields.description: Number of contributing firms rating the ticker as strong buy.

fields.name: analyst_count_strong_sell
fields.description: Number of contributing firms rating the ticker as strong sell.

fields.name: analyst_count_total
fields.description: Total number of contributing firms covering the ticker with any rating. Sum of the five `analyst_count_*` buckets. `well_covered` fires when this is at least 10.

fields.name: analyst_count_with_target
fields.description: Number of contributing firms whose rating includes a published 12-month price target. Always ≤ `analyst_count_total`.

fields.name: analyst_target_price_high
fields.description: Highest single-analyst 12-month price target across contributing firms.

fields.name: analyst_target_price_low
fields.description: Lowest single-analyst 12-month price target across contributing firms.

fields.name: analyst_target_upside_pct
fields.description: Implied upside from the current price to the consensus target, in percent. `(analyst_consensus_target_price - price) / price * 100`. Negative when price is above target. Recomputed every minute during market hours.

fields.name: ask
fields.description: Best ask from the consolidated NBBO at the most recent snapshot tick.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: ask_size
fields.description: Round lots at the ask. Raw count — NOT multiplied by 100.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: asset_class
fields.description: Asset class of the ticker: stocks, rates, crypto, or fx.

fields.name: asset_type
fields.description: Asset class. One of `equity`, `etf`, or `crypto`.

fields.name: assets
fields.description: Total assets on the balance sheet as of the most recently reported quarter.

fields.name: atr_14
fields.description: 14-day Average True Range.

fields.name: atr_percent
fields.description: ATR(14) as a percent of price. Useful as a volatility filter.

fields.name: avg_volume_10d
fields.description: 10-day trailing average daily volume.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: avg_volume_30d
fields.description: 30-day trailing average daily volume.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: basic_average_shares
fields.description: Weighted-average basic shares outstanding for the quarter. Denominator for basic EPS.

fields.name: basic_earnings_per_share
fields.description: Basic EPS for the most-recently reported quarter. Signed.

fields.name: benefits_costs_expenses
fields.description: Benefits and post-employment costs line item, where reported. Mostly insurance / utility issuers.

fields.name: beta
fields.description: Trailing beta vs SPY. Null for issuers with insufficient price history.

fields.name: bid
fields.description: Best bid from the consolidated NBBO at the most recent snapshot tick.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: bid_size
fields.description: Round lots at the bid. Raw count — NOT multiplied by 100. Multiply by 100 to get share count.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: bollinger_lower
fields.description: Lower Bollinger band (20-period, 2σ).

fields.name: bollinger_middle
fields.description: 20-day SMA — the centerline of the Bollinger band. `bollinger_upper` and `bollinger_lower` are already documented; this fills in the missing middle.

fields.name: bollinger_pct_b
fields.description: Position within Bollinger bands. 0 = at lower band, 1 = at upper band, >1 = outside.

fields.name: bollinger_upper
fields.description: Upper Bollinger band (20-period, 2σ).

fields.name: bollinger_width
fields.description: `(bollinger_upper − bollinger_lower) / bollinger_middle`. Normalized width — measures volatility regime. Narrow widths often precede expansion (see `bollinger_squeeze` in flags.ts).

fields.name: book_value
fields.description: Trailing-12m book value per share. Computed from `equity_attributable_to_parent / diluted_average_shares`.

fields.name: branding_icon_url
fields.description: URL of the company's square icon image.

fields.name: branding_logo_url
fields.description: URL of the company's logo image.

fields.name: cap_class
fields.description: Market-capitalization tier. One of `nano` (<$50M), `micro` ($50M–$300M), `small` ($300M–$2B), `mid` ($2B–$10B), `large` ($10B–$200B), `mega` (≥$200B), or `unknown` when `market_cap` is null. Updates daily post-close as `market_cap` moves. Preferred over the legacy `nano_cap/micro_cap/small_cap/mid_cap/large_cap/mega_cap` boolean columns (which remain in sync as backward-compat shortcuts).

fields.name: cash_on_hand
fields.description: Cash plus cash equivalents — the most-liquid balance-sheet line.

fields.name: change_1m
fields.description: Percent change vs. close ~21 trading days ago. Daily; see `change_1w` for note.

fields.name: change_1w
fields.description: Percent change in close vs. the close 5 trading days ago. Computed post-close; does NOT update intraday — use `from_open_pc` + `day_change_pct` for intraday-aware change.

fields.name: change_1y
fields.description: Percent change vs. close ~252 trading days ago.

fields.name: change_3m
fields.description: Percent change vs. close ~63 trading days ago.

fields.name: change_6m
fields.description: Percent change vs. close ~126 trading days ago.

fields.name: change_ytd
fields.description: Percent change since the first trading day of the calendar year.

fields.name: cik
fields.description: SEC Central Index Key — the company's identifier in EDGAR filings.

fields.name: composite_figi
fields.description: Composite FIGI — Bloomberg's cross-exchange security identifier.

fields.name: cost_of_revenue
fields.description: Cost of goods sold for the quarter.

fields.name: costs_and_expenses
fields.description: Total costs and expenses reported on the income statement (COGS + opex).

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO country code of the issuer.

fields.name: currency_name
fields.description: Currency the prices are quoted in (`usd`, `eur`, `gbp`, etc.). Effectively always `usd` for US-listed equities.

fields.name: current_assets
fields.description: Assets expected to be converted to cash or used up within 12 months.

fields.name: current_liabilities
fields.description: Liabilities due within 12 months — accounts payable, short-term debt, accrued expenses.

fields.name: current_ratio
fields.description: Current assets ÷ current liabilities. Short-term liquidity. >1 = able to cover short-term obligations from current assets.

fields.name: day_change
fields.description: Absolute change vs `previous_close`.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: day_change_pct
fields.description: Percent change vs `previous_close`. Expressed as a decimal fraction (0.05 = 5%), not a whole percent.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: day_dollar_volume
fields.description: Today’s cumulative dollar volume traded.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: day_vwap
fields.description: Today’s session volume-weighted average price.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: days_down
fields.description: Consecutive trading days closing lower than the prior close. Resets to 0 on an up day.

fields.name: days_since_52w_high
fields.description: Trading days since the most recent 52-week high.

fields.name: days_since_52w_low
fields.description: Trading days since the most recent 52-week low.

fields.name: days_to_cover
fields.description: Short interest divided by 30-day average daily volume. Trader’s "how many days of normal trading to cover all shorts" measure.

fields.name: days_to_earnings
fields.description: Calendar days until next earnings announcement. Negative after report.

fields.name: days_up
fields.description: Consecutive trading days closing higher than the prior close. Resets to 0 on a down day.

fields.name: debt_to_equity
fields.description: Total debt divided by total shareholders' equity. Common leverage ratio; lower = less leveraged.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Business description of the company.

fields.name: diluted_average_shares
fields.description: Weighted-average diluted shares outstanding for the quarter. Denominator for diluted EPS.

fields.name: diluted_eps_ttm
fields.description: Trailing-12m diluted EPS.

fields.name: dividend
fields.description: Most-recent dividend amount per share.

fields.name: dividend_date
fields.description: Date of the most-recent dividend payment.

fields.name: dividend_frequency
fields.description: Payment frequency: `quarterly`, `monthly`, `semiannual`, `annual`.

fields.name: dividend_yield
fields.description: Forward dividend yield as a fraction (0.025 = 2.5%). Null for non-payers.

fields.name: earnings_beat_streak
fields.description: Consecutive quarters the company has beaten consensus EPS estimates. Resets to 0 on a miss.

fields.name: earnings_date
fields.description: Next scheduled earnings announcement date. Null if not scheduled.

fields.name: earnings_fiscal_quarter
fields.description: Fiscal quarter the next earnings report covers (e.g. "2026Q1"). Distinct from calendar quarter — covers companies whose fiscal year doesn't match the calendar.

fields.name: earnings_growth_yoy
fields.description: Year-over-year EPS growth percent from the most recently reported quarter vs. the same quarter prior year. Signed; positive = growth.

fields.name: earnings_report_time
fields.description: When in the trading day the next earnings will be reported. One of `BMO` (before market open), `AMC` (after market close), `DMH` (during market hours).

fields.name: ebitda
fields.description: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (TTM).

fields.name: ema_12
fields.description: 12-day EMA. Fast-side input of canonical MACD (`macd = ema_12 − ema_26`).

fields.name: ema_21
fields.description: 21-day EMA. Often paired with `ema_9` for short-trend bias; also serves as a dynamic-support reference.

fields.name: ema_26
fields.description: 26-day EMA. Slow-side input of canonical MACD (`macd = ema_12 − ema_26`).

fields.name: ema_9
fields.description: 9-day exponential moving average of close. Most-recent-weighted; reacts faster than the same-period SMA. Commonly paired with `ema_21` for short-trend bias.

fields.name: enterprise_value
fields.description: Market cap + total debt − cash.

fields.name: eps
fields.description: Earnings per share (trailing twelve months).

fields.name: eps_estimate_revision_down_30d
fields.description: Count of analysts who lowered their next-quarter EPS estimate in the last 30 days.

fields.name: eps_estimate_revision_up_30d
fields.description: Count of analysts who raised their next-quarter EPS estimate in the last 30 days. A positive read on forward sentiment momentum.

fields.name: equity
fields.description: Total shareholders' equity.

fields.name: equity_attributable_to_noncontrolling_interest
fields.description: Equity attributable to minority shareholders of consolidated subsidiaries. Usually 0 for non-conglomerates.

fields.name: equity_attributable_to_parent
fields.description: Equity attributable to the parent entity's shareholders (excludes minority interest).

fields.name: etf_holders
fields.description: ETFs that hold this ticker, ordered by the ticker's weight within each (the reverse of ETF holdings). Filter with array operators in /v2/scan, e.g. `'SPY' = ANY(etf_holders)` to find SPY constituents. Refreshed nightly post-close.

fields.name: ev_to_ebitda
fields.description: `enterprise_value` ÷ `ebitda`. Capital-structure-neutral profitability multiple.

fields.name: ev_to_sales
fields.description: `enterprise_value` ÷ `revenue_ttm`. Capital-structure-neutral revenue multiple.

fields.name: exchange
fields.description: Primary listing exchange, human-readable name — e.g. `NASDAQ`, `NYSE`, `NYSE Arca`, `Cboe BZX`, `NYSE American`. See `exchange_mic` for the raw ISO 10383 code. Null for a small number of delisted/edge names.

fields.name: exchange_mic
fields.description: Primary listing exchange as an ISO 10383 **MIC code**: `XNAS` = NASDAQ, `XNYS` = NYSE, `ARCX` = NYSE Arca, `BATS` = Cboe BZX, `XASE` = NYSE American. The `?exchange=` filter accepts either this code or the human name.

fields.name: fixed_assets
fields.description: Property, plant, and equipment (PP&E), net of accumulated depreciation.

fields.name: float_effective_date
fields.description: As-of date for the current float-shares figure.

fields.name: float_shares
fields.description: Public float (shares available to trade).

fields.name: forward_pe
fields.description: Forward price-to-earnings ratio using next-12m consensus EPS. Lower = cheaper on forward basis.

fields.name: free_cash_flow
fields.description: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures. Cash the business generates above what it needs to maintain operations.

fields.name: free_float_percent
fields.description: Percent of shares outstanding actually available for trading (excludes insider / restricted holdings).

fields.name: from_open_pc
fields.description: Intraday: percent change from today’s session open to the latest snapshot price. Resets at session boundary.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: gap
fields.description: Overnight gap as percent: `(today_open − prev_close) / prev_close`. Signed — positive = gap up, negative = gap down. Use this for custom gap thresholds; the boolean shortcuts `gap_up` (≥3%) and `gap_up_extreme` (≥10%) cover the canonical levels.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: gap_pct
fields.description: Percent change of `session_open` vs `previous_close`. One value per session.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: gross_margin
fields.description: `gross_profit / revenues` for the quarter.

fields.name: gross_profit
fields.description: `revenues − cost_of_revenue` for the quarter.

fields.name: gross_profit_ttm
fields.description: Trailing-12m gross profit.

fields.name: high_20d
fields.description: Highest trade in the trailing 20 trading days.

fields.name: high_20d_eod
fields.description: Highest close over the last 20 trading sessions. Close-basis. For the intraday-wick variant use `at_20d_high`.

fields.name: high_52w
fields.description: Highest trade in the trailing 52 weeks (live, includes today).

fields.name: high_52w_date
fields.description: Date the trailing-52-week high was set. Useful for "fresh 52w highs in the last 30 days" scans.

fields.name: high_52w_eod
fields.description: Highest close over the trailing 52 weeks. The `_eod` distinguishes from the canonical intraday `52_week_high` (which captures wicks).

fields.name: high_5d
fields.description: Highest intraday high over the last 5 trading sessions, inclusive of the current session.

fields.name: high_5d_eod
fields.description: Highest close over the last 5 trading sessions. Close-basis (no intraday wicks) — pair with `high_5d` to distinguish.

fields.name: homepage_url
fields.description: Company homepage URL.

fields.name: inactive_at
fields.description: When the ticker was marked inactive.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: inactive_reason
fields.description: Why the ticker was marked inactive (e.g. delisted, stale data).
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: income_loss_from_continuing_operations_after_tax
fields.description: After-tax income from continuing operations for the quarter.

fields.name: income_loss_from_continuing_operations_before_tax
fields.description: Pre-tax income from continuing operations for the quarter.

fields.name: income_tax_expense_benefit
fields.description: Income tax expense (positive) or benefit (negative) for the quarter.

fields.name: income_tax_expense_benefit_deferred
fields.description: Deferred portion of income tax. Rare line item.

fields.name: industry
fields.description: GICS industry within the sector.

fields.name: inventory
fields.description: Inventory on hand. NULL for service and financial companies that don't carry inventory.

fields.name: ipo_date
fields.description: Date of the company's IPO, when known.

fields.name: last_20d_high_date
fields.description: Date the trailing-20-day high was set.

fields.name: last_20d_low_date
fields.description: Date the trailing-20-day low was set.

fields.name: last_earnings_surprise
fields.description: `last_reported_eps − last_eps_estimate`. Signed; positive = beat.

fields.name: last_earnings_surprise_pct
fields.description: Beat as percent of consensus.

fields.name: last_eps_estimate
fields.description: Consensus EPS estimate going into the most recent earnings announcement.

fields.name: last_rating_action
fields.description: Action taken in the most recent rating change. Common values: `upgrades`, `downgrades`, `initiates_coverage_on`, `maintains`, `reiterates`, `assumes`, `reinstates`, `suspends`.

fields.name: last_rating_date
fields.description: Date of the most recent rating action across all firms covering the ticker.

fields.name: last_rating_firm
fields.description: Name of the firm that issued the most recent rating action.

fields.name: last_reported_eps
fields.description: Actual EPS reported in the most recent earnings announcement.

fields.name: liabilities
fields.description: Total liabilities on the balance sheet.

fields.name: liabilities_and_equity
fields.description: Total liabilities + total equity. Should equal `assets` (balance-sheet identity). Documented for completeness — useful as a sanity check rather than a scan target.

fields.name: list_date
fields.description: Date the symbol was first listed on its exchange.

fields.name: long_term_debt
fields.description: Long-term debt obligations. Often NULL because issuers fold this into `noncurrent_liabilities` instead of breaking it out.

fields.name: low_20d
fields.description: Lowest trade in the trailing 20 trading days.

fields.name: low_20d_eod
fields.description: Lowest close over the last 20 trading sessions. Close-basis.

fields.name: low_52w
fields.description: Lowest trade in the trailing 52 weeks (live, includes today).

fields.name: low_52w_date
fields.description: Date the trailing-52-week low was set.

fields.name: low_52w_eod
fields.description: Lowest close over the trailing 52 weeks.

fields.name: low_5d
fields.description: Lowest intraday low over the last 5 trading sessions, inclusive of the current session.

fields.name: low_5d_eod
fields.description: Lowest close over the last 5 trading sessions. Close-basis.

fields.name: macd_histogram
fields.description: MACD line minus signal. Positive when bullish, negative when bearish.

fields.name: macd_line
fields.description: MACD line (12-EMA minus 26-EMA).

fields.name: macd_signal
fields.description: MACD signal line (9-EMA of MACD line).

fields.name: market_cap
fields.description: Market capitalization. Updated daily; intraday change derived from `price` × `shares_outstanding`.

fields.name: min_close
fields.description: Current minute bar’s most-recent close (last print).
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: min_day_accumulated_dollar_volume
fields.description: Today’s cumulative dollar volume across the session so far.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: min_day_accumulated_volume
fields.description: Today’s cumulative shares traded across the session so far (4 AM ET onward).
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: min_dollar_volume
fields.description: Current minute bar’s dollar volume (close × volume approximation).
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: min_high
fields.description: Current minute bar’s running high.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: min_low
fields.description: Current minute bar’s running low.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: min_open
fields.description: Current minute bar’s open. Updates every snapshot tick during market hours.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: min_trade_count
fields.description: Current minute bar’s number of trades.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: min_volume
fields.description: Current minute bar’s accumulated shares traded.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: min_vwap
fields.description: Current minute bar’s volume-weighted average price.
fields.cadence_label: Every 1 min, 4 AM–8 PM ET weekdays

fields.name: minus_di
fields.description: -DI (14-period): the bearish directional-movement component of the ADX system.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Company or asset display name.

fields.name: net_cash_flow
fields.description: Sum of operating + investing + financing cash flow — period change in cash.

fields.name: net_cash_flow_continuing
fields.description: Total cash flow excluding discontinued operations. Rare line item — populated only for companies in active discontinued-ops winddown.

fields.name: net_cash_flow_from_financing_activities
fields.description: Net cash from financing (debt, dividends, buybacks).

fields.name: net_cash_flow_from_financing_activities_continuing
fields.description: Financing cash flow excluding discontinued operations.

fields.name: net_cash_flow_from_investing_activities
fields.description: Net cash from investing activities (capex, acquisitions). Negative for net spend.

fields.name: net_cash_flow_from_investing_activities_continuing
fields.description: Investing cash flow excluding discontinued operations.

fields.name: net_cash_flow_from_operating_activities
